newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end down, seen falling.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end down, seen falling.

text.p: Pakistani stocks finished 1.57 percent down on Monday on profit-taking ahead of settlement day on Tuesday, dealers said.
"The market may fall further on Tuesday as more players square their positions, but I see support around the 1,625-point level," dealer Ali Asghar of Fortune Securities said.
The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index fell 26.14 points to close at 1,640.91 with 257 losers and 33 gainers.
Bank of Punjab fell 3.65 rupees to 28.75 and Pakistan State Oil 2.50 to 309.
